text:
alex.procure: Heads up — incoming shipment has a firmware variance. 50/200 units reported with firmware v2.1 instead of v2.3. 3 DOA so far. Need RMA & routing plan, customs implications, and whether we can expedite replacements.
mira.ops: ugh. can you paste the serials for the flagged units? any pattern or same batch code?
alex.procure: quick list: H100-AX-1001, H100-AX-1023, H100-AX-1100 (DOA). Full serial sheet on our drive: https://drive.redwood/example (private). Batch code MLK-0924. Vendor admits production mix.
james.logistics: If returned, depot intake will require a clear RMA AWB and separate manifest for 'pre-flash' vs 'to-be-patched'. Depot policy: no mixed-firmware on one pallet — they'll reject. :grimacing:
sara.vendor: Sorry about the mix. We can pre-flash 50 replacement units and ship by air in ~72h if you cover expedite uplift. Remaining units (after triage) can be reflashed at our depot in 10 days and sent by sea.
mira.ops: what's expedite uplift cost and lead time for vendor-side reflash?
sara.vendor: Air expedite = USD 18,000 (total), lead ~72h for the 50. Depot reflash for rest = 10 business days; no uplift for sea. We'll provide manufacturer letter confirming non-hardware change.
alex.procure: customs note: FRA customs sometimes hold shipments where manifests indicate 'firmware modification'. @customs-ops any guidance?
customs-ops: Manufacturer letter + serial manifest usually suffices. If manifest flags 'modified' they may ask for proof of warranty/repair scope. Best to include an explicit RMA reference and invoice showing warranty coverage (value zero or credited). Keep HS code unchanged.
de pot-bot: Depot intake slot provisional: FRA-DC-07 reserved 2024-11-05 09:00 UTC for 1 pallet. Please confirm AWB and RMA labels.
james.logistics: Can we split flow: air replacements -> AMS (to avoid hold) and sea/reflash -> FRA-DC? That reduces hold risk and keeps the depot workflow clean.
sara.vendor: Yes we can split shipments. We'll need two PO amendments for freight terms and two AWB/MAWB numbers. We'll preprint RMA labels for both sets.
mira.ops: please ensure vendor prints separate manifests and tags the air batch as 'RMA replacement - warranty' to avoid customs valuation questions. Also ensure foam/packing is identical — last time foam mismatch caused a 24h staging delay.
sara.vendor: confirmed same foam insert and packing dimensions. sending serial list + manufacturer letter now.
alex.procure: also note 3 DOA — vendor to accept immediate credit or swap?
sara.vendor: DOA under warranty. We'll include replacements in the air uplift and create credit memos for the DOA units. No customer invoice for replacements.
james.logistics: I'll prepare AWBs and customs docket. recommend routing air to AMS hub to mitigate FRA hold. If AMS accepts same-day clearance, we'll save storage costs.
mira.ops: agreed. route air -> AMS, sea -> FRA depot for vendor reflash. Create two RMA label sets: one for AMS air inbound, one for FRA sea inbound.
alex.procure: please also include a contact at vendor depot for on-site reflash acceptance tests — we want a signoff sheet with post-flash serial checks.
sara.vendor: adding test engineer contact: luca@vendor.example (will sign post-flash manifest). We'll also attach a checksum log per serial.
james.logistics: note for customs-ops: ensure AWB declares 'RMA — warranty replacement' and include vendor letter as supporting doc; otherwise FRA might request additional paperwork.
customs-ops: ack. we'll prep template wording for the commercial description to avoid triggering valuation review.
de pot-bot: Action created: RMA set rma-1754328888-ams and rma-1754328888-fra. Depot intake instructions appended to manifest.
mira.ops: I'm going to open a short-lived internal ticket to track logistics + customs and link the vendor docs. tagging procurement + logistics.
alex.procure: vendor, pls send AWB numbers and amended PO when ready. once i have that i'll finalize the expedite approval. :thumbsup:
sara.vendor: AWB numbers incoming in ~30m, PO amendments sent. thanks all.
james.logistics: cheers — I'll follow up with tracking + customs docket and confirm depot acceptance window.
